place: Hot Pie Pizza, West Palm Beach
note: Thin crust and hot wings between Virgin and Margaritaville.
Plantains in the tortilla, lime soda, patio mesh table.
Fixed seasonal tasting (VV Insider / onboard placards). Menu A Mar 3: Mushroom; Egg Yolk / Caviar; Scallop / Ham; Beef or Venison Tenderloin; Chocolate. Lab-style five courses on Brilliant Lady.
Guacamole with pomegranate, Esquites, Aguachile / ceviche, Cabernet; Cochinita Pibil; Pato with mole ahumado and smoked yam puree; pork on mole as plated; Tacos de Chocolate.
Quick-dining oven on Deck 7. Egg with cracked pepper, pepperoni with roasted garlic, another egg with basil — worth the late-night reputation.
Extra Virgin wine tasting — flights lined up, bread on the side.
Hands-on rolls in The Test Kitchen — mats, nori, fillings, then bento trays with ginger and seaweed salad.
Corn Custard & Black Bean Salad, Hamachi Crudo, bone-marrow brioche rolls; Hanger Steak / Filet and New Zealand Lamb Chops; chocolate hazelnut tart and berry bowl.
Poached Shrimp cocktail and citrus salad; Steak & Eggs; The Wake Benedict under hollandaise.
Pulpo a la Grill, Jamón Ibérico with marcona almonds, montaditos; Arctic Char with artichokes; grilled ribeye with chorizo piperade; Basque Cheesecake and Churros with chocolate hazelnut fondue.
Banchan by the grill; seafood combo / bulgogi / chef combo on the circular BBQ; charcoal soft-serve and Hotteok sweets.

Menu B Mar 7 (placards Mar 7–10): Corn / Truffle; Salmon / Cucumber; Shrimp / Garlic; Lamb Rack; Strawberry / Pistachio — plus Beet / Cashews and Mango / Chia from the veg list. Longer sailings get all three menus.
Menu C Mar 11 (placards Mar 1–2 & 11): Scallop / Black Garlic; Cheese Tart; Study of Chicken; Yuzu / Meringue — plus Coconut / Berries from the veg side. Study of Chicken is the standout.
Jamón, Patatas Bravas Ahumadas, Pimentón Cheese, Pulpo — Spanish specialty table; Basque Cheesecake and chocolate dessert to finish.
Trumpet Royale Mushrooms, Grilled Shrimp, Fire-Roasted Chicken Thigh, Beef Kafta Skewer — open-fire grill on embark afternoon.
